subject.title: Feature: Respect userTimezone in memory file timestamps and naming

question: Should bundled session-memory artifact filenames and `# Session` headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` instead of the gateway host/TZ timezone?
rationale: Current docs and shipped behavior define session-memory as host-local, while memory-core pre-compaction flush already uses the configured user timezone; changing the hook affects persisted artifact names and needs product intent.

options.title: Adopt existing userTimezone
options.body: Make session-memory filenames and headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` with host fallback, and update focused docs/tests without adding a new config key.

options.title: Keep host-local session-memory
options.body: Leave the shipped host/TZ behavior in place and document that session-memory differs from memory-core pre-compaction flush.

options.title: Add a memory-specific timezone
options.body: Introduce a memory-only timezone setting only if maintainers want independent control and accept the extra config surface.

recommendation.title: Adopt existing userTimezone
recommendation.body: Make session-memory filenames and headers use `agents.defaults.userTimezone` with host fallback, and update focused docs/tests without adding a new config key.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the current session-memory timezone behavior and is the strongest routing candidate for deciding whether that hook should change semantics.
